# Holistic Vet Directory

> Holistic Vet Directory (holisticvetdirectory.com) is a searchable U.S. directory of holistic and integrative veterinarians. Pet owners can browse practitioners by location and specialty, including acupuncture, herbal medicine, chiropractic care, nutritional therapy, Traditional Chinese Veterinary Medicine (TCVM), homeopathy, laser therapy, and rehabilitation.

## Quick Facts

- **What it is:** Free, searchable directory of holistic and integrative veterinarians across the United States.
- **Who runs it:** An independent publisher led by founder Kevin Collins, created after his family's search for holistic veterinary support for their rescue dog.
- **How listings are handled:** Listings are compiled from publicly available practice information and practitioner directories, then checked for basic relevance before publication. Practices can submit corrections or new listings.
- **Cost:** Free for pet owners. Basic listings are free for practitioners.
- **Important note:** Educational content is general information only and is not a substitute for advice from a licensed veterinarian.

## Main Pages

- [Homepage](https://holisticvetdirectory.com/): Search for holistic and integrative vets by location and specialty
- [All Vets](https://holisticvetdirectory.com/vets/): Complete directory entry point
- [Specialties](https://holisticvetdirectory.com/specialties/): Overview of holistic veterinary specialties
- [Blog](https://holisticvetdirectory.com/blog/): Lower-risk guides and site updates
- [About](https://holisticvetdirectory.com/about/): Mission, editorial standards, and founder background
- [Submit a Practice](https://holisticvetdirectory.com/submit/): Suggest a listing or correction
